numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Adding a non-vectorized offset with a sub-unit offset parameter (e.g. CustomBusinessDay(offset=pd.Timedelta(1))) to a non-nano DatetimeIndex (unit='s') incorrectly rounds the result, because _add_offset casts the result back to self.dtype via as_unit(self.unit), truncating sub-unit precision; in some cases apply_wraps can leave a raw datetime.datetime, causing AttributeError on a subsequent tz_localize call.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The result should keep the finer resolution between self.unit and offset.offset's unit (e.g. nanosecond precision from pd.Timedelta(1)) rather than being truncated back to self.unit; the lossy as_unit conversion should not produce an AttributeError.

provenance.value: Adding a non-vectorized offset with a sub-unit offset parameter (e.g. CustomBusinessDay(offset=pd.Timedelta(1))) to a non-nano DatetimeIndex (unit='s') incorrectly rounds the result, because _add_offset casts the result back to self.dtype via as_unit(self.unit), truncating sub-unit precision; in some cases apply_wraps can leave a raw datetime.datetime, causing AttributeError on a subsequent tz_localize call.

The result should keep the finer resolution between self.unit and offset.offset's unit (e.g. nanosecond precision from pd.Timedelta(1)) rather than being truncated back to self.unit; the lossy as_unit conversion should not produce an AttributeError.
